source.timeframeNotes: active load window (ramp-up -> plateau 12rpm -> ramp-down); single-service agent app, no noise classifier hits
queries: fetch spans | filter is_root_span && service.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent' | sort start_time asc | summarize takeFirst(span.name) by trace.id | summarize count() by entryOp  (front-end discovery -> single entry request)
fetch logs | filter k8s.container.name=='istio-proxy' | summarize count()  (access-log probe -> 0, spans-only)
fetch spans | join [spans|sort start_time asc|summarize collectArray(span.name) by trace.id] on trace.id  (JOURNEY reconstruction: ReAct loop vs single LLM round)
fetch spans | filter request && summarize countIf(span.name=='execute_tool') by trace.id | summarize count() by usesTool  (archetype split via AGENTIC_TOOL_PATTERNS)
fetch spans | filter request | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),avg by usesTool  (per-archetype baseline)
fetch spans | filter request | summarize count() by bin(start_time,1m)  (G3-B arrival curve + CoV 0.233 -> ramp)
fetch spans | filter request | summarize sum(duration) over active window  (observed concurrency)

journeys.description: Conversational — pure-LLM turn (single round); no tool. Reconstructed internal flow: request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> finalize -> message.sent  (single LLM round)

Agentic — tool-using turn (ReAct: LLM -> tool -> LLM); reaches execute_tool. Reconstructed internal flow: request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> execute_tool -> Tool Usage -> llm.call -> chat -> finalize -> message.sent  (ReAct loop: LLM -> tool -> LLM)
